world.title: Critical One-Click Vulnerability in Atlassian’s Rovo AI Exposed Enterprise Data
world.summary: The RovoBlast attack method identified by Varonis researchers could have been exploited to steal Confluence, Jira and SharePoint data. The post Critical One-Click Vulnerability in Atlassian’s Rovo AI Exposed Enterprise Data appeared first on SecurityWeek .

world.title: Atlassian Rovo Can Be Tricked Into Sending Jira and Confluence Data to Attackers
world.summary: Attacker-controlled instructions can make Atlassian's Rovo assistant collect Jira or Confluence data that a signed-in user can access, then send it to an outside server. Two security firms found that behavior independently, by different routes.
